instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use first candidate; no need to rank

grasp(candidate)

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
